info.title: Example.AsyncApiDemo | v1
info.description:
AsyncAPI documentation for TDLib (Telegram Database Library) communication patterns as exposed by the bielu.tdsharp.extensions libraries.

## Architecture

TDLib uses a layered architecture:
1. **Application** sends requests via `TdApi.IClient` (Send / Execute / ExecuteAsync)
2. **TdJsonClient** serializes requests to JSON and forwards them to the native TDLib library
3. **Receiver** polls the native library for responses and updates in a background loop
4. **Events** are fired back to the application (UpdateReceived, AuthorizationStateChanged)

## Channel Categories

- **Auth** — Authorization state machine (login flow)
- **Messages** — Sending, receiving, editing, and deleting messages
- **Operations** — Querying Telegram data (users, chats, options, files)
- **Updates** — Server-pushed events (status changes, notifications, connection state)

tdlib.description: TDLib native JSON client (tdjson). Communication happens via FFI calls to the native C++ library, not over a network socket. The 'server' represents the TDLib engine running in-process.

telegramauthstate-changed.description: Authorization state change events. TDLib transitions through multiple states during authentication: WaitTdlibParameters → WaitPhoneNumber → WaitCode → WaitPassword → Ready. Applications must handle each state to complete login.

telegramauthset-phone-number.description: Send the user's phone number to begin the authentication flow.

telegramauthcheck-code.description: Submit the authentication code received from Telegram.

telegramauthlog-out.description: Log out from the Telegram session. The session is terminated permanently on the server.

telegramoperationsget-me.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information.

telegramoperationsget-chat.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific chat.

telegramoperationsget-chats.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the user's chats.

telegramoperationsget-user.description: Retrieve information about a Telegram user.

telegramoperationsget-option.description: Retrieve a TDLib configuration option value (e.g. 'version', 'commit_hash').

telegramoperationssearch-messages.description: Search for messages matching a query within a specific chat.

telegramoperationsdownload-file.description: Download a file from Telegram servers to the local filesystem.

telegramoperationsclose.description: Close the TDLib client instance. The session is preserved and can be resumed later.

telegrammessagesnew.description: New message events. Fired when a new message is received in any chat the authenticated user is a member of.

telegrammessagescontent-changed.description: Message content change events. Fired when an existing message is edited.

telegrammessagessend-succeeded.description: Message send success events. Fired when a pending message has been sent successfully.

telegrammessagessend-failed.description: Message send failure events. Fired when a message could not be sent.

telegrammessagessend.description: Send a message to a Telegram chat. Supports text, photos, videos, documents, and more.

telegrammessagesedit-text.description: Edit the text content of a previously sent message.

telegrammessagesforward.description: Forward messages from one chat to another.

telegramupdatesuser-status.description: User online status change events. Fired when a contact's online status changes.

telegramupdatesuser.description: User profile update events. Fired when a user's profile information changes.

telegramupdateschat-last-message.description: Chat last message change events. Fired when the last message in a chat changes (new message received or previous last message deleted).

telegramupdateschat-read-inbox.description: Chat read inbox state events. Fired when messages are marked as read in a chat.

telegramupdatesfile.description: File download/upload progress events. Fired during file transfer operations.

telegramupdatesconnection-state.description: Connection state change events. Fired when the connection to Telegram servers changes.

telegramupdatesoption.description: TDLib option value change events. Fired when an internal configuration option is updated.

TelegramAuthChannel_OnAuthorizationState.title: TelegramAuthChannel_OnAuthorizationStateChanged_Subscribe
TelegramAuthChannel_OnAuthorizationState.description: Receive notifications when the TDLib client's authorization state changes. The payload is a TdApi.AuthorizationState subclass indicating the new state. States include: AuthorizationStateWaitTdlibParameters, AuthorizationStateWaitPhoneNumber, AuthorizationStateWaitCode, AuthorizationStateWaitPassword, AuthorizationStateReady, AuthorizationStateLoggingOut, AuthorizationStateClosing, AuthorizationStateClosed.

TelegramAuthChannel_SetAuthenticationPho.title: TelegramAuthChannel_SetAuthenticationPhoneNumber_Publish
TelegramAuthChannel_SetAuthenticationPho.description: Sends a phone number to TDLib to initiate the login process. After sending, the authorization state will transition to WaitCode.

TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationC.title: TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationCode_Publish
TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationC.description: Sends the authentication code to TDLib. If the code is correct and no 2FA password is set, the authorization state transitions to Ready.

TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationP.title: TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationPassword_Publish
TelegramAuthChannel_CheckAuthenticationP.description: Sends the two-factor authentication password to TDLib. Required when the account has a cloud password set.

TelegramAuthChannel_LogOut_Publish.title: TelegramAuthChannel_LogOut_Publish
TelegramAuthChannel_LogOut_Publish.description: Sends a logout request to TDLib. The authorization state transitions to LoggingOut → Closing → Closed. The session is permanently invalidated.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetMe_Pu.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetMe_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetMe_Pu.description: Returns a TdApi.User object with the authenticated user's profile (ID, name, username, phone number, profile photo, etc.).

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChat_.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChat_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChat_.description: Returns a TdApi.Chat object with the chat's title, type (private/group/channel), photo, last message, unread counts, and other metadata.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChats.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChats_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetChats.description: Returns an ordered list of chat IDs. Use with a ChatList (Main, Archive, Folder) and a limit to paginate through the user's conversations.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetUser_.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetUser_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetUser_.description: Returns a TdApi.User object for the specified user ID, including name, username, phone number, status, and profile photo.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetOptio.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetOption_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_GetOptio.description: Returns the value of a TDLib internal option. Common options include 'version' (TDLib version), 'commit_hash', 'my_id' (current user ID), and various configuration flags.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_SearchCh.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_SearchChatMessages_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_SearchCh.description: Searches for messages in a chat by text query, sender, message type, or date range. Returns a paginated list of matching messages.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_Download.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_DownloadFile_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_Download.description: Initiates a file download. The file will be downloaded to the TDLib files directory. Progress can be tracked via UpdateFile events.

TelegramClientOperationsChannel_Close_Pu.title: TelegramClientOperationsChannel_Close_Publish
TelegramClientOperationsChannel_Close_Pu.description: Closes the TDLib client gracefully. The user session is preserved on disk — recreating the client will resume the session without re-authentication. The authorization state will transition to Closing → Closed.

TelegramMessagingChannel_OnNewMessage_Su.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_OnNewMessage_Subscribe
TelegramMessagingChannel_OnNewMessage_Su.description: Receive notifications when new messages arrive. The payload contains the full TdApi.Message object including sender, chat ID, content, and metadata.

TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageConten.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageContentChanged_Subscribe
TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageConten.description: Receive notifications when the content of a message changes (e.g. text edit, media replacement). Provides the chat ID, message ID, and new content.

TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendSu.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendSucceeded_Subscribe
TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendSu.description: Receive a notification when a message previously sent by the client has been delivered to the server. Contains the old temporary message ID and the new permanent one.

TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendFa.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendFailed_Subscribe
TelegramMessagingChannel_OnMessageSendFa.description: Receive a notification when a message failed to send. Contains the error code and message describing the failure reason.

TelegramMessagingChannel_SendMessage_Pub.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_SendMessage_Publish
TelegramMessagingChannel_SendMessage_Pub.description: Sends a message to the specified chat. The InputMessageContent determines the type of message (text, photo, video, etc.). Returns a Message object with a temporary ID that will be updated via UpdateMessageSendSucceeded.

TelegramMessagingChannel_EditMessageText.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_EditMessageText_Publish
TelegramMessagingChannel_EditMessageText.description: Edits the text of a message. Can only edit messages sent by the current user in non-channel chats, or any message in a channel the user administers.

TelegramMessagingChannel_DeleteMessages_.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_DeleteMessages_Publish
TelegramMessagingChannel_DeleteMessages_.description: Deletes one or more messages from a chat. The Revoke parameter controls whether messages are deleted for all users or only the current user.

TelegramMessagingChannel_ForwardMessages.title: TelegramMessagingChannel_ForwardMessages_Publish
TelegramMessagingChannel_ForwardMessages.description: Forwards one or more messages to a target chat. Options include sending as a copy and removing captions.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserStatusUpdat.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserStatusUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserStatusUpdat.description: Receive notifications when a user's online status changes (online, offline with last-seen timestamp, recently, last week, last month).

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserUpdate_Subs.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnUserUpdate_Subs.description: Receive notifications when a user's profile changes (name, username, profile photo, bio, etc.).

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatTitleUpdate.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatTitleUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatTitleUpdate.description: Receive notifications when a chat's title is updated.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatLastMessage.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatLastMessageUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatLastMessage.summary: Subscribe to chat last message updates
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatLastMessage.description: Receive notifications when the most recent message in a chat changes. This is typically used to update chat list UI elements.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatReadInboxUp.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatReadInboxUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatReadInboxUp.summary: Subscribe to chat read state changes
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatReadInboxUp.description: Receive notifications when the read pointer advances in a chat (e.g. the user read messages in another client). Contains the new last-read incoming message ID and unread count.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatNotificatio.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatNotificationSettingsUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnChatNotificatio.description: Receive notifications when a chat's notification settings are modified (mute duration, sound, show preview, etc.).

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnFileUpdate_Subs.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnFileUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnFileUpdate_Subs.description: Receive progress notifications during file downloads or uploads. Contains the file ID, expected size, downloaded size, and local/remote file info.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnConnectionState.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnConnectionStateUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnConnectionState.description: Receive notifications when the network connection state changes: WaitingForNetwork, ConnectingToProxy, Connecting, Updating, Ready.

TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnOptionUpdate_Su.title: TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnOptionUpdate_Subscribe
TelegramUpdatesChannel_OnOptionUpdate_Su.description: Receive notifications when a TDLib internal option value changes. Options include 'my_id', 'unix_time', 'online', and many others.
